summary: Full backend and frontend testing of GlobalSync AI app. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend is fully functional with one notable bug: History tab always shows empty because no component saves to /api/history after AI queries.

ui_bugs.issue: History tab always shows 'No queries yet'. Dashboard.js comment says 'save to history is handled inside each component' but neither TimeConverter.js nor CurrencyConverter.js nor AIInput.js call POST /api/history. The /api/history endpoint works correctly but is never called from frontend.

integration_issues.issue: AI correctly detects meeting_overlap intent and routes to Time tab, but does not auto-populate the cities from the AI query into the World Clocks or trigger overlap automatically. User still needs to manually add cities and click Find Meeting Overlap.

action_items: Fix history saving: After each AI query result in AIInput.js (handleSubmit), call POST /api/history with query, intent, and result. The result needs to be passed back from TimeConverter/CurrencyConverter or from the AI dispatch handler in Dashboard.js.
(Optional UX) When AI detects meeting_overlap with cities, auto-add those cities to TimeConverter and trigger overlap
critical_code_review_comments: HISTORY BUG: Dashboard.js line 21 comment says 'save to history is handled inside each component' but grep shows zero history API calls in TimeConverter.js and CurrencyConverter.js. The POST /api/history is never called from frontend.

AIInput.js only calls /api/ai/parse and returns intent to parent - it doesn't have the final computed result (conversion result / overlap result) to save, so history saving logic needs to be in the individual components after they process the aiDispatch.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (history saving broken, all other features working)

seed_data_creation: None - history was cleared during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: all APIs working (health, timezone/convert, timezone/overlap, currency/convert, currency/trend, ai/parse, history CRUD). Frontend: Landing page, AI omnibar, Dashboard tabs, Time Zones (live clocks, add city, remove city, overlap button), Currency (convert + 7-day trend chart), AI routing - all working. Only History tab broken because components never call POST /api/history.
rca_of_issue: History never saved: Dashboard.js handleAIResult() receives the intent/entities from ai/parse but each tab component (TimeConverter, CurrencyConverter) independently makes their own API calls. The result of those calls is never bubbled back up to Dashboard.js or sent to /api/history. Fix: in CurrencyConverter after successful conversion call `axios.post(API+'/history', {query, intent:'currency_conversion', result})`. Same for TimeConverter after conversion/overlap.
